## Summary

**All visual assets are generated by code at run time.** No third-party
models, textures, audio files, fonts or images are bundled in the repository
or production build. Quran audio streams from MP3Quran.net. The recorded
Haram adhan streams from a version-pinned public mirror described below.
No recordings are bundled with the project.

After `npm install` fetches the code dependencies, `npm run build` and the
visual simulation work offline. Quran and adhan playback require internet access to
the external providers. The scene remains a procedural reconstruction, with
no photographic reference textures.

## Third-party code dependencies

| Package | Version | Licence | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `three` | ^0.185.1 | MIT | WebGL renderer, maths, scene graph |
| `vite` | ^8.2.2 | MIT | Dev server and production bundler (build only) |
| `typescript` | 5.9.3 | Apache-2.0 | Type checking (build only) |
| `vitest` | ^5.0.0 | MIT | Test runner (development only) |
| `playwright` | 1.56.0 | Apache-2.0 | Headless visual QA (development only) |
| `@types/three`, `@types/node` | — | MIT | Type definitions (build only) |

Only `three` is present in the shipped bundle. Everything else is a build- or
development-time tool.

## Generated assets

Each of these is produced by a named function at start-up. The "cost" column
is measured, not estimated; see TEST-REPORT.md.

| Asset | Generator | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Marble (3 tones) | `env/Materials.ts` → `marbleTexture` | Value-noise veining over a flat base, at 128–512 px depending on quality |
| Kiswah cloth | `env/Materials.ts` → `kiswahMaps` | Twill weave height field → colour, normal and roughness maps |
| Dressed stone (2 tones) | `env/Materials.ts` → `stoneMaps` | Coursed ashlar with offset joints, plus a derived normal map |
| Gold relief | `env/Materials.ts` → `goldReliefMaps` | Abstract interlace only — see "What is deliberately absent" |
| Sky dome | `env/Environment.ts` → `buildSky` | Gradient shader; also the source for the pre-filtered environment map |
| Contact shadow | `characters/CrowdRenderer.ts` | 8-segment disc with a radial alpha ramp |
| Character mesh (3 LODs) | `characters/CharacterMesh.ts` | Ring-based procedural body, garment, head, limbs |
| Character animation | `characters/AnimationBank.ts` | 19 clips, baked to a vertex-animation texture at start-up |
